_comment: Alt text for gallery photos, keyed by the source filename build-gallery.ts read them from. Written from each photo's own EXIF: the coordinates and date are the camera's, and the elevation is that coordinate sampled against the USGS 3DEP 10m DEM, the same source the footer ridgeline is drawn from. Kept here rather than in gallery.json because that file is generated.
IMG_8178: San Gabriel Mountains, California, 8,180 ft. Sunset from the ridge near Windy Gap in January, ranges going flat and blue behind each other, the dog already heading down the scree ahead of me.
IMG_3880: New York Harbor, December. Lower Manhattan at dusk from the water, One World Trade rising over the rest of the skyline and the lights just coming on.
IMG_2650: San Juan Mountains above Ouray, Colorado, 9,700 ft. Late April, snow still filling the couloirs on the ridge above the spruce.
IMG_7713: The Monterey Peninsula coast, California, at sea level. The dog with his nose up in the coastal scrub, eyes shut, yellow in flower behind him.
IMG_5866: Near Silverton, Colorado, 9,260 ft. Mid September, a whole hillside of aspens turning gold against the dark spruce.
IMG_5833: San Juan Mountains near Red Mountain Pass, Colorado, 10,200 ft. A bull moose standing in the willows across the basin.
IMG_5177: Rocky Mountain National Park, Colorado, 9,330 ft. A bull moose on the cut bank below the aspens, close enough to count the points.
IMG_5650: Independence Pass, Colorado, 12,130 ft. Standing out on the tundra bench with the red talus of the peak behind, weather building over the divide.
IMG_6346: San Gabriel Mountains, California, 6,670 ft. Late September on the way up South Mount Hawkins, Mo in his black harness standing in a shallow creek between granite boulders, tongue out.
IMG_6412: South Mount Hawkins, San Gabriel Mountains, California, 7,760 ft. Late September, the last sunlight turning the high ridge to the east orange, a pine and a bush of yellow wildflowers lit up in front of it.
IMG_4753: South Mount Hawkins, San Gabriel Mountains, California, 7,760 ft. Late September, the Harvest Moon six minutes after it rose, gold through the haze between two forested ridges.
IMG_6444: South Mount Hawkins, San Gabriel Mountains, California, 7,760 ft. Late September, red and orange cloud bands over the dark silhouettes of the surrounding peaks.
IMG_6458: South Mount Hawkins, San Gabriel Mountains, California, 7,760 ft. Late September, the full moon half an hour up, gone white over the range at dusk, above pines and wildflowers.
IMG_6564: La Jolla Cove, San Diego, California. Early October, mid-morning under the marine layer, a pile of sea lions asleep on the sandstone above the surf.
IMG_6576: San Diego, California. Early October, a turtle hauled out on a log among the reeds, sunning itself in the middle of the day.
IMG_6592: Torrey Pines State Beach, San Diego, California. Early October, early afternoon, the sun nearly overhead and the Torrey Pines bluffs ahead along the coast path.
IMG_6610: Mission Beach, San Diego, California, at sea level. Early October, late afternoon at the end of a 15 mile run down the coast, La Jolla and Mount Soledad on the hill behind.
IMG_1674: Chapin Mesa, Mesa Verde National Park, Colorado, 6,920 ft. Mid December, early afternoon, Lulu in a brown fleece sweater stepping across the sandstone rim, backlit, the canyon and the far mesas behind.
IMG_4080: The Ironbound, Newark, New Jersey, at sea level. The day after Christmas, late evening, Buddy out in the snow under the streetlights, flakes settling on his coat.
IMG_4972: Interstate 40 across western Tennessee. Early January, late afternoon on the drive west, Mo sitting bolt upright on his bed in the passenger seat, watching the bare winter woods go by.
IMG_5536: Rio Grande National Forest near South Fork, Colorado, 8,670 ft. Early January, late morning, Buddy standing in the snow among the pines, sun coming through the trees, a line of lichen-covered rocks in front of him.
IMG_9617: Dead Horse Point State Park, Utah, 5,930 ft. Early April, early evening, Buddy and Mo sitting side by side on the slickrock past a twisted juniper, the canyon country running out to a long bank of cloud.
IMG_0344: Endovalley, Rocky Mountain National Park, Colorado, 8,560 ft. Early April, early afternoon, Lulu on the cobbles beside the Fall River, leash in frame, tongue just out.
IMG_2555: Bear Creek Trail above Telluride, Colorado, 9,290 ft. Late April, early evening, Mo out ahead where snowmelt runs across the trail, the aspens still bare and the cliffs above holding the last snow.
IMG_2717: Above Telluride, Colorado, 9,840 ft. Late April, the last sun on the ridge, Mo looking straight at the camera with the valley falling away behind him.
IMG_2937: Near Ouray, Colorado, 8,880 ft. Late April, midday, Buddy close up with his mouth open, the snow behind him gone to a blur.
